hooks.command: command -v rintel >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo 'rintel plugin: the rintel command is not on PATH, so its skills and MCP server cannot run. Install it with: go install github.com/spro1/rintel/cmd/rintel@latest (and make sure $(go env GOPATH)/bin is on PATH), or download a release binary from https://github.com/spro1/rintel. Tell the user this if they ask for something rintel would answer.'
